The Bolivian Army is organized into ten territorial divisions, titled Army Divisions (AD), plus a mechanized division. These divisions generally correspond to the administrative departments, with some overlapping.
RM 1 covers most of La Paz Department and includes the 1st Army Division, 1st Mechanized Division, 297th MPB C.L.Saavedra, 296th En Btn CNL R.C.Zabalegui, BE-297, and BATLOG-1.
RM 2, based in Potosí, covers the departments of Oruro and Potosí and includes the 2nd and 10th ADs, 1st RR, 24th RR M.Arcos, and ADA-202.

RM 3, based in Tarija, consists of Tarija Department and eastern Chuquisaca and southern Santa Cruz, and includes the 3rd and 8th ADs, 273rd MPB R.Amezaga, BE-298, 12th RR Manchego, BATLOG-3, and the 292 army aviation company.
The 1st Mechanized Division is located in Viacha (La Paz Department) and includes the 1st Field Artillery Regiment "Camacho" and the 6th Air Defense.
